violations.description: Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. -Splatter at interior and front bottom edge of ice machine bin. -Minimal pink residue at back interior panel of ice machine.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. -1 case of single use cups stored on floor in dry storage area. -1 case of items stored on floor in office area.
